label: PF Backlog 419
title: ADR: PF platform shipped editions use compiled artifacts (Go core + compiled-Python), never raw .py; one source, many editions
body: Context: PF platform is 100% Python; deploying it on-prem/OEM exposes readable source (IP/reverse-engineering risk). Decision: ship compiled artifacts only; Go for new shipped/sensitive logic and for migrated high-value modules; compiled-Python (Nuitka) for the remainder; one source with build profiles (no per-edition forks); licensing + signed updates for value retention. Consequences: partial protection for compiled-Python remainder; Go migration cost; dev stays Python. Register in the A0 architecture decision register.
